declares.name: brickken
declares.description: Use Brickken dapp API, Agentic API, CLI, and MCP for tokenization, STO, ERC-8004 agent, reputation, agent-owned token, and ERC-8226 RAMS agent-mandate workflows. Use when Codex needs to help an AI agent choose between API-key access, x402/private-key access, the brickken CLI, or the Brickken MCP; grant, revoke, extend, or inspect a RAMS mandate; prepare or send Brickken transactions; explain required credentials; build safe command/API payloads; or troubleshoot Brickken API/CLI/MCP usage.
